name: speedtest-monitor
description: Self-hosted internet speed monitor. Runs Cloudflare Speed Test on a configurable schedule, stores every measurement in SQLite, and serves a dashboard with live updates over WebSocket. Includes alerts (webhook, ntfy, Discord, Slack, SMTP), authentication (local accounts and OIDC), and role-based access (admin / viewer). On first boot, set AUTH_SECRET (required) and BETTER_AUTH_URL (required when accessed behind a reverse proxy). Either set SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_EMAIL + SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD to seed the first admin, or visit /setup to create it from the UI. All other variables are optional. Data is persisted to /data (mapped to /mnt/user/appdata/speedtest-monitor by default).

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (speedtest.db).

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP + WebSocket port served by the app.

variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: REQUIRED. Secret used to sign session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the dashboard, used by Better Auth for sign-in callbacks and OIDC redirects (e.g. https://speedtest.example.com). REQUIRED when running behind a reverse proxy. Defaults to http://localhost:PORT if unset - fine for direct local access only.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_INTERVAL_MINUTES
variables.description: Default measurement interval in minutes (1-1440). Can be changed at runtime from /settings without restarting.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: First-run admin email (optional). When set together with SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD, the admin is auto-seeded on every boot (idempotent). Leave empty to use the /setup wizard instead.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: First-run admin password (optional, min 10 chars). Used together with SPEEDTEST_ADMIN_EMAIL. Updating this value rehashes the admin password on the next boot.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the dashboard (e.g. https://speedtest.example.com). Used to build deep links in alert emails. Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_LOCALE
variables.description: BCP 47 locale for dates and times in the dashboard and alert emails (e.g. en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Requires v1.13.0 or later.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_TIMEZONE
variables.description: IANA timezone for dates and times in the dashboard and alert emails (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York). Requires v1.13.0 or later.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_TEST_DURATION_S
variables.description: Duration of each download/upload phase in seconds. Raise to 20-30 for multi-Gbps links so TCP slow-start does not dominate the sample.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_PARALLEL_STREAMS
variables.description: Parallel HTTP streams per phase. Increase (e.g. 16) on very high-bandwidth links to saturate the pipe.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_DB_PATH
variables.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file. Must live under the App Data volume.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal HTTP port. Only change if you know what you are doing - must match the WebUI port mapping above.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Generic webhook URL for alerts (optional). Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_WEBHOOK_HEADERS
variables.description: Optional JSON object of extra headers for the generic webhook (e.g. {"Authorization":"Bearer xxx"}).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_NTFY_URL
variables.description: Full ntfy URL including the topic, e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-topic. Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_NTFY_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional ntfy access token (for protected topics).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for alerts (optional).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SLACK_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Slack incoming webhook URL for alerts (optional).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP server hostname for email alerts (optional). Required together with SPEEDTEST_SMTP_FROM and SPEEDTEST_SMTP_TO to enable email.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_PORT
variables.description: SMTP port. Defaults to 587 (STARTTLS).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_SECURE
variables.description: 'true' for implicit TLS (port 465), 'false' for STARTTLS, leave empty for auto-detect from port.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_USER
variables.description: SMTP username (optional, for authenticated SMTP).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_PASS
variables.description: SMTP password (optional, for authenticated SMTP).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_FROM
variables.description: Sender address for alert emails, e.g. speedtest@example.com.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SMTP_TO
variables.description: Recipient address for alert emails (single address or comma-separated list).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_ISSUER
variables.description: OIDC issuer URL (optional), e.g. https://auth.example.com. Required together with the client id/secret to enable SSO.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: OIDC client id (optional).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: OIDC client secret (optional).

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME
variables.description: Label shown on the OIDC sign-in button.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Email of the user to auto-promote to admin on first OIDC sign-in.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_OIDC_ALLOW_NEW_USERS
variables.description: 'true' to auto-create accounts on first OIDC sign-in, 'false' to require admin pre-provisioning.
